entries.title: Intel has reportedly signed a preliminary deal to produce chips for Apple
entries.summary: Is it 2006 again?
entries.excerpt: Following more than a year of "intensive talks,"The Wall Street JournalreportsApple has reached a preliminary agreement with Intel for the former titan to produce some of the chips that power its devices. The scale of agreement is unknown at this time. As theJournalnotes, Apple has recently shipped more than 200 million iPhones per year, and needs a steady supply of silicon for millions of other devices, including iPads and Mac computers.
